question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella for community skill lifecycle work, or should maintainers decompose it into specific security/API, ClawHub publish, trigger metadata, and agent-pack trackers?
rationale: The remaining work defines public skill metadata, ClawHub service behavior, permission/trust boundaries, and potential plugin/API contracts that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split work
options.body: Use this issue as the consolidation tracker while maintainers create or endorse narrow implementation issues for permission/trust, trigger metadata, publish reliability, and agent-pack composition.

options.title: Close in favor of narrower trackers
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers choose the canonical open issues that fully preserve the remaining work and link them from the close comment.

options.title: Move service-only publishing work out
options.body: Route standalone clawhub CLI or hosted ClawHub publish failures to the ClawHub owner project while keeping OpenClaw API/security gaps here.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split work
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the consolidation tracker while maintainers create or endorse narrow implementation issues for permission/trust, trigger metadata, publish reliability, and agent-pack composition.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest local history signal for ClawHub install, skill security, and skill-system architecture points to steipete.
